description: This source file is a shell script that generates a UBI image configuration, defines functions for UBI volume creation and layout, and processes command-line arguments to produce an output image file.

methods.name: ubivol
methods.description: Defines and outputs parameters for a UBI volume. Supports different volume types, sizes, and optional image resizing.

methods.name: ubilayout
methods.description: Creates a layout of UBI volumes based on input parameters, such as root filesystem type and images, including special handling for uboot environment and kernel.

methods.name: set_ubinize_seq
methods.description: Sets a sequence string for ubinize if SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH is defined, to ensure reproducibility.
